title: Renaming and removing
question: A name moves, a directory will not go while it has names in it, and a file goes when its last name does. What does ext4 do?
text: Call 1, [renameat2(AT_FDCWD, "/mnt/dir/a.txt", AT_FDCWD, "/mnt/dir/b.txt", 0)](1): [ext4_rename](1:ext4_rename) In one directory: the entry's name changes, "a.txt" to "b.txt"; the inode stays as it is.
Call 2, [unlinkat(AT_FDCWD, "/mnt/dir", AT_REMOVEDIR)](2): [ext4_empty_dir](2:ext4_empty_dir) Is it empty? No ("b.txt"): the call fails, ENOTEMPTY.

Call 3, [unlinkat(AT_FDCWD, "/mnt/dir/b.txt", 0)](3): [ext4_delete_entry](3:ext4_delete_entry) The name leaves the directory block. [ext4_free_inode](3:ext4_free_inode) It was the file's only name, and nobody has it open: its inode is freed.
Call 4, [unlinkat(AT_FDCWD, "/mnt/dir", AT_REMOVEDIR)](4): [ext4_free_blocks](4:ext4_free_blocks) Now empty: the directory's block goes back to the block bitmap, and its inode is freed.
